ui.LblInstructions: Please configure UUPD.Compose to create your ISO
ui.LblComposeInfo: UUPD.Compose creates an ISO-File from a previous download from https://uupdump.net.
ui.LblDownloadSettings: Where is the download from uupdump.net?
ui.TxtImportantInformation:
Creating the ISO file can take a considerable amount of time (depending on the computer).
It may appear as though the program has stopped responding. Terminating the program
prematurely could result in data loss. Therefore, please wait until the program clearly
indicates that creating the ISO file has been finished.
